text:
Kaya (Docs): opened a tiny PR to add an Optimize toolkit rollup: concise batching + kv-prefetch + quant migration guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288 (draft)
Rohan G.: can we make the page 1) include per-route Node and Python examples 2) a small mapping YAML for legacy quant names 3) a one-line decision rule for q4_0 vs q8_0? Keep it pasteable.
Kaya (Docs): yes — keeping examples minimal. adding per-route Node + Python and a mapping block.
Mina (Runtime): use timeoutMs=10 in snippets and call out when not to batch (sub-100ms SLOs, multi-turn stateful agents). Also mention kv_prefetch increases host RAM proportional to stored KV size.
Kaya (Docs): got it. draft Node snippet:
```
import {RedwoodClient} from '@redwood/inference-js';
const c = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});
await c.createRoute('summaries', {model: 'open-llama-13b-v2', batching: {maxTokensPerBatch: 1000, maxBatchSize: 6, timeoutMs: 10}, kv_prefetch: {enabled: true, ttlSeconds: 300}});
```
Kaya (Docs): mapping YAML inline: `legacy_small: q4_0  # validate on evals; prefer q8_0 if quality drops; legacy_large: q8_0`
ci-bot: linkcheck failed on PR #1288: 1 broken link to old model alias open-llama-13b. Logs: https://ci.redwood/1288/linkcheck
Kaya (Docs): fixed model alias and updated a stale import from @redwood/sdk to @redwood/inference-js. pushed.
bench-bot: small synth run (batch=6): q4_0 median token-latency 38ms, q8_0 median 56ms; token-cost delta ~ -30% for q4_0. gist: https://bench.redwood/q4q8-rollup
Rohan G.: please add that single-sentence tradeoff and an anchor id #optkit-rollup for release notes. Also prefer present-tense imperative voice in copy.
Kaya (Docs): added tradeoff sentence, anchor, and switched tone. requesting final review from Mina.
Mina (Runtime): LGTM. approve after CI passes.
Kaya (Docs): thanks all — will merge after green CI :tada:
